messages:
Sara (Sales): Heads up — Helion Labs just flagged an exec-level blocker on the POC. CTO is asking for a same-day bridge. Primary blockers: SSO integration failing for their Okta certs, throughput regression vs our benchmark, and a pricing question from procurement about seat-based vs usage discount. Can we assemble a quick bridge and list owners?

Rahul (Presales): I can run the pricing scenarios. Do we have their actual steady-state QPS and token mix? Procurement asked for examples with 100k tokens/day and a peak of 250 reqs/min.

Jun (SRE): Noted. I pulled the POC fleet logs — seeing increased latency at TTL ~512 tokens. I can repro locally but need a dedicated perf run against their dataset.

Alex (EngOps): I ran a short perf job against the dedicated pool earlier. Attached snippet: 
```
wrk -t4 -c120 -d30s https://dedicated.redwood.internal/helion/generate 
--header 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```
Observed p95 ~ 420ms on quantized model variant, p95 jumps to ~980ms when KV cache miss rate >18%.

Sara (Sales): Maria, can you confirm whether Helion will accept SOC2 + iso doc set, or do they want a full security questionnaire? They're asking for encryption-in-transit proof and key management options.

Maria (CISO): They'll want the questionnaire filled for legal, but we can start by sharing SOC2 + our KMS attestation. I'll attach the SAML/SSO runbook and the KMS playbook. Also need to know if they're requesting BYO-KMS.

OpsBot (runbook): Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/poc-exec-bridge. Checklist item 3.2: "Confirm IdP cert thumbprint + sample SAML assertion".

Rahul (Presales): For pricing, two paths we can offer: 1) usage-based with a committed monthly minimum and a 15% commit discount, 2) hybrid seat + usage where core engineers on fixed seats + overage charge. For a mid-sized Helion forecast (100k tokens/day), commit path is ~20% cheaper. I can draft numbers if someone confirms their expected monthly token count.

Jun (SRE): For the perf test I need a sanitized prompt set and their token distribution. Sara can you get that from their SRE/QA contact? Also suggest we try the kv-prefetch patch (build: kv-prefetch v2) — reduces miss rate by ~10-12% in our last run.

Alex (EngOps): Will open capacity ticket for a canary with kv-prefetch v2 on a dedicated node pool. Ticket: #CAP-2418. ETA for canary: 3 hours if nobody objects.

Maria (CISO): If they're asking BYO-KMS we need legal to sign the data access addendum. Ops: can Helion's key be rotated without downtime? Quick answer: yes, with our multi-phase rollover; I'll paste the KMS rollover steps in a sec.

Sara (Sales): Action items: Rahul prep pricing slide for exec bridge; Jun run perf with their prompts + kv-prefetch v2; Alex spin canary + share ticket; Maria to share SOC2 artifacts and KMS rollover steps; I'll schedule 2pm PT bridge and invite Helion CTO + our sales exec.

Rahul (Presales): I'll have a draft pricing slide in 90 mins. Will include both commit + hybrid examples and an early-adopter concession option.

Jun (SRE): Perf run started against sample set (sanitized) — tail logs: 
```
[2026-03-23T09:08:45Z] run:start id=prf-998 
[2026-03-23T09:09:02Z] p95=390ms p99=820ms kv_miss=6.2% 
[2026-03-23T09:10:15Z] p95=360ms p99=700ms kv_miss=4.8% (after prefetch)
```
Looks promising. Will post full CSV when done.

Alex (EngOps): Canary up: https://internal.redwood/canaries/CAP-2418 — routing 3% traffic. No errors so far.

Maria (CISO): SOC2 + KMS attestation links: https://vault.redwood/artifacts/soc2-2025.pdf, https://vault.redwood/artifacts/kms-attest.pdf. For SSO: please attach the IdP metadata XML; that will speed the handoff.

Sara (Sales): Perfect. I'll grab the IdP metadata from Helion infra and push to the thread. Can someone drop a one-liner we can use in the exec bridge invite on the resolution plan?

Rahul (Presales): One-liner: "Redwood will run a focused perf canary with kv-prefetch v2, provide SOC2 + KMS attestation, and present a tailored pricing commitment to close the POC." :thumbsup:

Sara (Sales): Love it. Scheduling now. Thanks team — I'll post invite + agenda in 10 mins. :eyes:
